title: Experiments, Services, and Permission Boundaries
description: Five top stories and twelve briefs follow protein experiments, biotech workflows, speech models, shared-link exposure, and the limits of permission and deployment.

claude-binders.verification_scope: Methods, the test of 211 candidates, and limitations in the official research introduction; the experiment was not independently reproduced

openai-orchestra.verification_scope: Full original TechCrunch report; the OpenAI announcement could not be read and is not presented as an official text

deepinfer.date_note: Reported October 20, 2026; this issue read the official repository
deepinfer.verification_scope: Official repository README; the October 20 publication lead came from a 36Kr report, and a fetch time is not treated as the publication time

voxtral3.verification_scope: Product, language coverage, and interaction description in the official announcement; vendor performance comparisons were not independently verified

meta-shared-chats.verification_scope: Full Verge report and Meta's response in it; the shared-link problem is not widened into a leak of all private chats

amie-study.verification_scope: Full official research introduction; it does not give a sample size that could support a general safety claim

grok-incidents.verification_scope: Full official case; earlier incidents mentioned in the case are not written as events of this day

torchtpu.verification_scope: Main integration and compatibility portions of the official technical introduction; not independently tested

mps-215.verification_scope: Main features and test conditions in the version introduction; the release candidate is not written as a stable release

local-perplexity.verification_scope: Full Verge brief; the official link could not be read, and the software was not installed and checked

figma-mcp.verification_scope: Full original interview; paraphrased, not translated back into a direct quotation

zoom-detection.verification_scope: Full Verge brief; no official implementation or measured accuracy was reviewed

cosmos-surgery.verification_scope: Opening, data, and key limitations of the authors' technical introduction; the full text was not read and the experiment was not reproduced

altk-evolve.verification_scope: Authors' method, held-out test, and results-table portions; not reproduced and not ranked across systems

anylanguage.verification_scope: Compatibility interface, features, and migration portions of the release introduction; not run

discourse-wang.verification_scope: Published q.cxspace.com detail page and the excerpts above; the full interview was not listened to again

fairstress.verification_scope: Definitions and evaluation design in the authors' method introduction; the full paper was not read and broad conclusions are not cited

deepseek-recipe.verification_scope: Function and boundary description in the official README, and the MIT license file

coverage_gaps.Anthropic News: Article bodies were not read through. The /research section is outside the configured entry point and only the first screen of the list was checked. Original pages in this round had day-level dates only.
coverage_gaps.Claude Blog: Dates are day-level only, and bodies were not read. The configured blog URL redirects to resources/articles. External claude.dev items took titles only from list data.
coverage_gaps.Google AI Blog: The AI-topic RSS is not a complete list of the innovation-and-ai homepage. The homepage shows about 20 links, so older window articles pushed off the homepage may be missed. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.xAI: Dates are day-level only. Headless rendering was blocked by Cloudflare, leaving static HTML. xAI accounts and documentation changelogs outside x.ai were not checked. Full bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured page has no list dates, and the configured feed returned HTTP 410. The AI-topic feed and the Source sitewide feed each contain only 10 items, which cannot establish full-window coverage. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured entry point is an old site and does not match the current official entry. Only the first rendered screen of qwen.ai/research was checked, without pagination. Hugging Face model-creation times are not announcement times; ModelScope and WeChat accounts were not checked. config/sources.json was not changed.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The configured homepage is a benefits page. News is actually on qianwenai.com/news and the release calendar, and the config was not changed. Only the default rendered view of the calendar was checked. WeChat accounts and Alibaba Cloud official news were not checked.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: The change log has day-level precision, so a boundary day may fall outside the window. Benchmark scores are the vendor's figures and were not independently verified. Repositories with pushes but no release, including DeepInfer, DeepGEMM, deepseek-recipe, and DeepJIT, were not reviewed commit by commit.
coverage_gaps.月之暗面 Moonshot: Blog posts were not opened one by one. The homepage may not list every product update. GitHub and Hugging Face were not checked.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: News and paper bodies were not read. The z.ai English site and GitHub or Hugging Face releases were not checked.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The official site has no news stream and no absolute dates. Commits in repositories such as Step-Code were not reviewed one by one. WeChat accounts and the Chinese site were not checked.
coverage_gaps.European Commission Digital Strategy: Dates are day-level, without hours or minutes. Bodies were not read. The section is not only AI, and non-AI titles were left for later selection rather than deleted.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: The page lists only the latest several article cards. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: If the embedded JSON is not the whole site, new articles not injected into the homepage are invisible. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: Abstracts and full texts were not read. Papers submitted after 2026-10-19T17:59:59+00:00 were not yet announced and were invisible to the API. Only new papers with a first submission inside the window were collected; replacement versions of older papers were not counted separately. The published field is submission time, not the arXiv announcement time. At check time, about 05:0x Beijing time on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, when US Eastern time was Tuesday 17:0x, the latest cs.AI/new listing was Tuesday, 20 October 2026, with 789 entries: 225 new, 261 cross-listed, and 303 replacements. That listing was announced at 20:00 US Eastern on Monday, 2026-10-20T00:00Z, and covers submissions from 14:00 US Eastern Friday to 14:00 Monday, 2026-10-16T18:00Z to 2026-10-19T18:00Z. Of this round's window, 2026-10-17T21:00Z to 2026-10-20T21:00Z, the portion 2026-10-17T21:00Z to 2026-10-19T18:00Z, about 45 hours, was announced, visible in the API, and collected. Submissions from 2026-10-19T18:00Z to 2026-10-20T21:00Z, about 27 hours, become visible only with the announcement at 20:00 US Eastern Tuesday, 2026-10-21T00:00Z, which is 08:00 Beijing time on October 21 and after this round's cutoff. That gap cannot be written as an absence of new papers.
coverage_gaps.Hugging Face Daily Papers: An empty list or HTTP 400 is not interpreted as there being no new papers. Listing date and arXiv submission date are recorded separately. Abstract pages were not opened one by one to check submission dates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: New submissions inside the window were not searched venue by venue. Announcement bodies were not opened.
coverage_gaps.GitHub Trending（日榜 + Python 日榜）: The snapshot is not a list of projects that are new inside the window. Items were not filtered for AI relevance.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: Bodies were not read through. Items by contributing authors were not traced to the first-publication platform, often a WeChat account. Promotion judgments looked only at wording at the start and end of the body. Promotion and event channels were not opened separately.
coverage_gaps.国家网信办·网信发布（AI 相关）: Bodies were not opened to confirm the publishing body and legal effect. List dates were taken from the URL path. AI relevance was judged from titles only.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Full texts were not opened. The paper list was checked only on page 1. A year in model navigation was not treated as a publication date.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Load More was not clicked; the visible cards were already earlier than the window. Chinese news and model-release pages on minimax.cn were not checked. Bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.TechCrunch: Bodies were not read during collection. Original reporting versus briefs such as In Brief was not classified at that stage.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Bodies were not read. The section may include syndicated items, and original versus relay status was not classified.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Bodies were not read. A summary or paywall was not treated as the full text. Suspected Insights sponsored content was not opened to confirm.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: Bodies were not read, so which investigations are AI-related cannot be determined. Dates are day-level, and times on boundary days are unknown. Non-AI titles were left for later selection rather than deleted. Some articles require a subscription or login and were not attempted.
